name: xcl-lang
description: xcl for TypeScript and Node: runs the bundled xcl engine, with the same Go plugins.

scripts.build:test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.decorators-standard.json && tsc -p tsconfig.decorators-legacy.json
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-timeout=300000 "build/test/test/unit/**/*.test.js" "build/decorators-*/test/decorators/*.test.js" "scripts/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-timeout=300000 "build/test/test/**/*.test.js" "build/decorators-*/test/decorators/*.test.js" "scripts/*.test.mjs"
